values.value: Finds: Bundle hierarchies nested more than 3 levels deep (bundle of bundles of bundles). Why it matters: Deep nesting catastrophically slows configurator load times, complicates pricing rule evaluation, and is a leading cause of CPQ governor-limit errors on large quotes. Customers experience 10+ second waits when configuring. Suppress a finding: when a complex telecom or industrial bundle genuinely requires deep nesting and the performance impact has been validated as acceptable. Disable the detector: only if your business model genuinely requires multi-level bundling (rare). Most orgs should leave this on.
